newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria Airways deal with Air France reaps profit.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria Airways deal with Air France reaps profit.

text.p: Nigeria Airways makes a profit of $110 on each passenger on a weekly Air France flight from the southeastern Nigerian oil city of Port Harcourt, the aviation ministry said on Tuesday.
A spokesman for the ministry told the News Agency of Nigeria that the deal was aimed at enhancing the revenue base of the airline to help it repay its debt of 7.5 billion naira.
Nigeria Airways lacks the aircraft to operate the flights and has been looking for partnerships with foreign airlines to service its routes.
The aviation spokesman said the deal with Air France was also meant to enhance the use of the Port Harcourt airport.

Port Harcourt is the nerve centre of Nigeria's oil industry and the flights, which began in January, allow passengers from there to fly abroad without having to travel to Lagos. Air France seperately operates a twice-weekly flight to Lagos from Paris.
